title: Exclusion of “Indian Mercantile Co-operative Bank Ltd., Lucknow” from the Second Schedule to the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934
description: Indian Mercantile Co-operative Bank Ltd., Lucknow has been excluded from the Second Schedule to the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934 vide Notification CO.DOR.RAUG.No.S1887/08.08.007/2026-27 dated June 04, 2026 and published in the Gazette of India (Part III - Section 4) dated June 22, 2026. (Brij Raj)            Chief General Manager Press Release: 2026-2027/673
